contactSharing.title: Thinking of moving to another app?
contactSharing.body: Anyone can record their screen. You do not have to share your contacts with a stranger, and you can report them.

solicitation.title: You do not have to do anything you are not comfortable with
solicitation.body: Never undress for a stranger. If someone threatens you, do not pay; report it. You can leave with Skip at any time.

linkHidden.title: Link hidden for safety
linkHidden.body: Links, handles and phone numbers are hidden in the first minutes of a call.

spam.label: Spam or scam
spam.hint: Ads, links or asking for money

reportError.notInRoom: This call can no longer be reported. Reports are accepted during a call and for 60 seconds after it.
reportError.rateLimited: You have sent several reports recently. Please wait a little and try again.
reportError.invalidPayload: The report was not accepted. Try again without the attachments.
reportError.withMessage: The report could not be sent: {{message}}
reportError.generic: The report could not be sent. Please try again.

lead.call: Sending a report ends this call.
lead.match: Sending a report skips this match.
lead.postCall: This call has ended. You can report it for up to 60 seconds after it ends.

reportSheet.title: Report {{who}}
reportSheet.titlePostCall: Report the person from your last call
reportSheet.nothingAttached: No image or chat is attached.
reportSheet.frameLabel: A still image of their video
reportSheet.onlyChecked: Only what is checked here is sent with your report.

postCall.question: Was something wrong with {{who}}?
postCall.countdown: You can report them for <s>{{seconds}}</s> more seconds.

tips.undress: Never undress or move to another app for a stranger.
tips.threats: If someone threatens you, do not pay; report it.
tips.flag: Use the flag on their video to report someone. You can leave any call with Skip.

helplines.us: United States: call or text 988 if you are in crisis. Report the sexual exploitation of a child to the NCMEC CyberTipline at report.cybertip.org or 1-800-843-5678.
helplines.anywhere: Anywhere: if you are in danger right now, call your local emergency number.

watermarkExplainer.title: The code over the video
watermarkExplainer.p1: During a call, a faint code (like "chizzy 7K3P-9QX2") shows over the other person's video. It is made from that call's id, not from anything about you. If a recording of a call turns up later, the code helps us find which call it came from when you report it.
watermarkExplainer.p2: It discourages recording, but it does not stop it. Anyone can record their screen or film it with another device, so only show on camera what you would be fine with a stranger keeping.

reasons.nudity: Nudity or sexual content on camera

appealStatus.pending: We received your appeal. A person on our team will review it.
appealStatus.upheld: Your appeal was reviewed and the restriction stays in place.
appealStatus.overturned: Your appeal was accepted and the restriction was lifted.

appealErrors.notFound: We could not find this restriction. It may have ended already.
appealErrors.alreadyAppealed: You have already appealed this restriction.
appealErrors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
appealErrors.network: Cannot reach Chizzy. Check your connection and try again.

restricted.title: Your access to matching is restricted
restricted.evidenceNote: For safety reasons we cannot show the material behind this decision.
restricted.appealLabel: Think this is a mistake? Appeal for free.
restricted.appealHint: Tell us what happened. A person reviews every appeal. {{length}}/{{max}}

blur.checking: Checking the video on your device...
blur.hiddenBody: Our on-device check thinks this video may show nudity.
blur.blurredBody: The safety check could not run on this device, so the video stays blurred.

inAppBrowser.title: Open Chizzy in {{browser}}
inAppBrowser.body: You opened this link inside {{app}}. Its built-in browser often cannot use your camera, so video chat may not work here.

steps.iosMenu: Tap the menu (the three dots or the share button).
steps.iosChoose: Choose "Open in Safari" or "Open in browser".
steps.androidMenu: Tap the menu (the three dots, top right).
steps.androidChoose: Choose "Open in Chrome" or "Open in browser".
steps.copy: Or copy the link below and paste it into {{browser}}.
